messages.subject: work session tomorrow, Wickson 2124
parts:
Hi All,

We'll have our regular work session tomorrow in Wickson 2124 from 1-3pm.  In the first half hour or so I'll be going over a few functions I've been finding useful lately.  Bring your questions & problems, we'll see you there!

Also, there are some exciting talks coming down the pipeline, so put 'em on your calendar:

10/13 - The Tidyverse (Michael Levy)

10/27 - RMarkdown (Ryan Peek)

11/10 - Unit Testing (Myfanwy Johnston)

More event announcements to come, stay posted!

Best,
Myfanwy

--
Myfanwy Johnston
Ph.D Candidate, UC Davis
Animal Behavior Graduate Group
Biotelemetry Laboratory
